idea: How traditional 'do important tasks first' advice fails for ADHD and why starting with interest is more effective.
limitingBelief: צריך להתחיל משימות חשובות קודם כל.
caption: כולם אומרים להתחיל עם משימות חשובות. אבל מה קורה כשזה לא עובד? המוח שלכם עובד אחרת לגמרי. גלו את הדרך שמתאימה לכם. איך אתם מתחילים לעשות דברים?
title: משימות חשובות? עדיף אחרת.

hook.en: Important tasks often never get started at all.

value.en: They tell you to start with urgent tasks.
But for your brain, that often fails.
Your brain needs novelty to engage fully.
Important things are not always exciting enough.
That's why nothing seems to move forward.
The common belief is that you are lazy.
But that widely held belief is wrong.
It's not laziness, it's how your brain works.
Instead, start with what genuinely interests you.
Your brain quickly latches onto things of interest.
From there, continuing becomes much easier.
Take one minute, start something different now.

turn.en: Suddenly, things begin to move forward.
The form was sent with surprising ease.
The long-awaited email finally got written.
Less effort, and more actually gets done.
